newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cent to 14.12 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cent to 14.12 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell one cent to 14.12 ringgit ($) a kg in tandem despite a higher close of the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Tuesday.
"There was selling at the start, but support came in when the market fell one cent and the price stayed," said a trader.
Initial offers outweighed bids by 133 tonnes 121. Final turnover was 123 tonnes compared to 90 on Tuesday. The market was closed on Wednesday for a religious holiday.
Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. The local premium over London narrowed to $55 from $65 previously.
